image_description: A vertical shot of a steep, sunlit limestone cliff face on the left. A young boy in green shorts is captured mid-air, jumping off the cliff with arms raised. Below him, two other figures (one in blue, one in white) stand on a sandy/rocky ledge watching. The background shows a clear blue sky and a distant horizon line over water.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The left side of the image is dominated by a high, vertical rock wall that clearly rises above the beach level.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The jumper's right arm (viewer's right) appears to merge indistinctly with the background sky or lacks defined fingers/hand structure, looking like a melted stump.
The feet are poorly defined against the background; the ankles seem to lack clear separation from the lower legs, suggesting slight melting or motion blur artifacts typical of AI generation.
The figure in blue on the lower left has ambiguous proportions and seems to blend slightly into the rock shadow, lacking crisp boundary definition.
